what: MANAGER-CHECKLIST.json is a single shared JSON array, so any PR that appends or edits a row conflicts on GitHub whenever main appends one. GitHub has no jsonregister merge driver; that driver exists only in a clone's local .git/config, which hides the conflict locally.
